crs.interpretation: Mars 2000 longitude/latitude in degrees, east-positive longitude, planetocentric latitude. The service states the Mars 2000 geographic CRS but not the latitude type; planetocentric is inferred by cross-validation (docs/GEO_DATA.md).

dropped: z vertex values (undocumented; not surface elevations)
attributes.lengthUnit: Not stated by the service. Metres is inferred: the sum of `length` matches the geometric length computed on the Mars sphere (see lengthCheck).

lengthCheck.note: Simplification removes small wiggles, so the simplified line is slightly shorter. Use the `length` attribute for driven distances, never the simplified geometry.

simplification.method: Douglas–Peucker per line, local tangent plane on the Mars 2000 sphere (R = 3,396,190 m)
